name: Procedural Instancing for Voxel Blocks
aliases: Cubic Grid Voxel Rendering with Instance Buffers
definition: A rendering technique using Unity's procedural instancing to render voxel blocks as individual instances, where each instance's position and clip distance are determined by a structured buffer.
summary: Procedural instancing for voxel blocks renders scenes using a shared cube template and instance buffers, replacing per-voxel mesh generation to drastically reduce memory usage and improve performance.
